模版:判断点在直线的哪边

$给定l:p,v ,判断q在l的哪边$ 想法：计算$pq \times v$ ,如果小于0在右边，大于0在左边

#define vc pair<int,int>

int driction(vc p,vc q,vc v){
	vc tmp;//pq
	tmp.first = q.first - p.first;
	tmp.second = q.second - p.second;
	return (v.first*tmp.second - v.second*tmp.first); 
}

模板:判断线段是否相交

跨立实验：另一条线段的两点应分步在线段的两侧 快速排斥实验：验证包围盒是否相交

#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
using namespace std;

#define vc pair<int,int>

int cross(const vc& a, const vc& b, const vc& c) {
    return (b.first - a.first) * (c.second - a.second) - (b.second - a.second) * (c.first - a.first);
}

bool quickReject(const vc& a, const vc& b, const vc& c, const vc& d) {
    return !(max(a.first, b.first) < min(c.first, d.first) ||
             max(c.first, d.first) < min(a.first, b.first) ||
             max(a.second, b.second) < min(c.second, d.second) ||
             max(c.second, d.second) < min(a.second, b.second));
}

bool onSegment(const vc& p, const vc& a, const vc& b) {
    return p.first >= min(a.first, b.first) && p.first <= max(a.first, b.first) &&
           p.second >= min(a.second, b.second) && p.second <= max(a.second, b.second);
}

bool segmentsIntersect(const vc& A, const vc& B, const vc& C, const vc& D) {
    if (!quickReject(A, B, C, D)) return false;
    int d1 = cross(A, B, C);
    int d2 = cross(A, B, D);
    int d3 = cross(C, D, A);
    int d4 = cross(C, D, B);
    if ((d1 > 0 && d2 < 0 || d1 < 0 && d2 > 0) &&
        (d3 > 0 && d4 < 0 || d3 < 0 && d4 > 0)) {
        return true;
    }
    if (d1 == 0 && onSegment(C, A, B)) return true;
    if (d2 == 0 && onSegment(D, A, B)) return true;
    if (d3 == 0 && onSegment(A, C, D)) return true;
    if (d4 == 0 && onSegment(B, C, D)) return true;
    return false;
}

int main(){
	vc a,b,c,d;
	cout<<segmentsIntersect(a,b,c,d);
	return 0;
}
